rules.name: BR-LIB.UC03-001 - Borrowing allowed
rules.description: A patron with a current card may borrow up to five items.
rules.rule_summary: A patron with a current card may borrow up to five items.

rules.name: BR-LIB.UC03-002 - Hold blocks loans
rules.description: A hold on the account blocks every new loan, even for a current card. Staff clear the hold to lift the block.
rules.rule_summary: A hold on the account blocks every new loan, even for a current card.

rules.name: BR-LIB.UC03-003 - Reset loan length
rules.description: Reset restores the saved loan length and discards the unsaved edit.
rules.rule_summary: Reset restores the saved loan length and discards the unsaved edit.

rules.name: BR-LIB.UC03-004 - Supervisor override
rules.description: A supervisor override allows one loan despite a hold, and records a reason code.
rules.rule_summary: A supervisor override allows one loan despite a hold, and records a reason code.
